versions.content: The ECU Manager module shall derive the wakeup sources to be checked (and used as the wakeupSource parameter) from the EcuMWakeup Source (see ECUC_EcuM_00152) bitfield configured for the current sleep mode. The integration code used for this callout must determine which wakeup sources must be checked.
